high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from TechCrunch.com. The article discusses the demand for semiconductors, particularly in the context of AI and electric vehicles (EVs), and the limitations of silicon as a material. It mentions that making more efficient chips requires new materials, which are less ubiquitous than sand. The text highlights a U.K. startup called Space Forge, headquartered in Cardiff, Wales. The company recently raised a £22.6 million (approximately $30 million) Series A funding to make wafer materials in space.
